summary: Well-structured test suite with good coverage of core policies (max-age, keep-latest, max-total-size), their interactions, modes (live/dry-run), config handling, JSON output, and error scenarios. Both unit tests (artifact-cleanup.bats) and integration tests via act (workflow.bats) are present. Strengths: clear organization with named sections, reusable assertion helpers, fixture-driven testing, YAML structure validation, actionlint integration, and act result capture. Gaps: fixture files themselves not shown for content validation; missing edge cases like special characters in names, extreme size values, and tie-breaking scenarios; shellcheck/bash -n validation not explicitly tested; some fragility in act output parsing (grep with multiple trailing numbers); unit tests run script directly which may conflict with "all tests through act" requirement. Would catch most regressions but lacks comprehensive boundary-condition coverage.
